profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Amazon Web Services (AWS)
profile.summary: Seasoned technical leader with proven experience delivering innovative products that delight customers. Strong record of forging strategic partnerships across technical and business disciplines to advance enterprise cloud computing technology. I live at the frontier of computing and am energized by the opportunity to build the future that customers demand at Amazon scale.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: I work with a passionate team of engineers charged with enabling AWS to expand and operate new cloud regions and services worldwide. We ensure customers have the right products and cloud presence in order to meet a diverse set of enterprise requirements. I enjoy working back from customer needs to design, develop, and build new product offerings that enable customers to succeed daily.

positions.title: Systems Development Engineer
positions.description: At Amazon we make innovation our daily habit and obsess over our customers to provide trusted cloud solutions worldwide. As an operations excellence engineer, I designed data-driven approaches to ensuring our systems are continuously increasing in quality and performance to deliver business value.

positions.title: Cyber Software Engineer
positions.description: Cyber Software Engineer for Northrop Grumman's Mission Systems sector. Led performance optimization research in cloud computing and big data platforms that utilized batch and streaming analytics. Developed new cloud capabilities to support Northrop Grumman customers in a variety of mission domain disciplines.

positions.title: Growth Hacker
positions.description:
Provided engineering and management expertise to the Gallup Growth Hacker team in Washington, D.C. as the project manager for several initiatives designed to support the growth of the Clifton StrengthsFinder tool to millions of new customers and clients at Gallup.

Previously, I supported Gallup as a Growth Hacker and Systems Application Developer creating solutions for Gallup's Technology Division. Led corporate initiatives to develop internal analytics and reporting capabilities for the StrengthsQuest team by using data mining techniques to improve lead generation and distribution. Achievements include empowering the StrengthsQuest team to surpass reaching over 10 million customers by developing a custom CRM platform for Gallup associates to discover, manage, and interact with new customers across the StrengthsQuest product line. Provided a unified data platform for Gallup's growth hacker technologies to effectively pre-process and share relevant data across Gallup's technology platforms.

positions.title: Advanced Systems Developer
positions.description: Designed solutions to support High Performance Computing (HPC) and scientific workflows via MAX’s Software Defined Networking Exchange (SDNX) and Giga-POP Fiber Optic Network services. Research activities funded by the National Science Foundation, which include creating enhancements to SDNX using OpenFlow and OpenStack technologies. Achievements include deploying an OpenStack cloud environment which supports SR-IOV and MACVTAP network transports for cloud tenants on MAX's development research network.

positions.title: Computer Scientist
positions.description: Developed SGT's big data and cybersecurity capabilities by leading research at SGT's Innovation Technology Center, and supporting NASA's Atmospheric Science Data Center (ASDC) through research, design, and prototyping of big data solutions for atmospheric science data at NASA Langley Research Center. Achievements include developing a prototype security monitoring system using Hadoop-related technologies, evaluating data platforms and developing software to enable Hadoop to interface with atmospheric datasets, and testing various system configurations for data processing as a member of the ASDC's Advanced Architecture Engineering Team (AAET).

positions.title: Langley Aerospace Research Scholar
positions.description:
Member of NASA Langley’s Information Management Branch working to develop data mining and text analytics capabilities using IBM Watson technology. Developed, administered, and designed data mining and analytics solutions based off of IBM’s Content Analytics software. Achievements include correcting critical server errors impeding usage, optimizing and enhancing server performance, creating an extensive data retrieval system for text analytics capable of handling multiple data types and sources, as well as managing system authentication and security standards. Architected a data knowledge assistant as a member of NASA Langley’s Comprehensive Digital Transformation (CDT) Team. Achievements include creating and successfully implementing a technology proof-of-concept utilizing Hadoop and MapReduce to demonstrate the technical capabilities of a recommendation and business intelligence system for use with NASA’s knowledge assistant architecture. Additional accomplishments include developing a Yammer API to enhance the center’s social media platform for integration with center-wide applications, as well as supporting Langley’s web technologies task. More details can be found in the NASA Work Portfolio (available upon request).

Manjula Ambur, Chief Knowledge Officer, NASA Langley Research Center:
"He is an outstanding young man with a rare combination of in-depth technical (software and hardware) skills, intelligence, quickness in learning, motivation to make a difference, and outstanding work ethic. "

positions.title: Chief Executive Officer
positions.description: Co-founder and C.E.O; Originally founded to provide IT consulting services and internet software solutions for commercial use, Maplegrove has grown into a secure and reliable hosting platform for individuals looking to create new communities in a high-performance environment.

courses.name: Advanced Seminar in Cybersecurity; Applied Reverse Engineering

publications.title: Virtually Impaired: The Consequences of Technological Advances in Gaming
publications.publisher: Interpolations Journal / University of Maryland · May 1, 2014
